lines.text: Many learners say: I like very much music.
Better: I like music very much.
Put very much after the thing you like.
Very much! I like pizza very much.

data.why: Put very much after the thing you like.

en.hook: Very much goes at the end!
en.tip: Learners keep “like very much” as one chunk, but very much goes after the thing you like: “I like music very much”
en.caption: Do you say “I like very much music”? 😅 Learners often keep “like very much” as one chunk, but very much goes after the thing you like. Say “I like music very much”! Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
